build_mp3d_eqa_config: build a python module to get the default MP3D EQA v1 dataset config for a given split
create_matterport3d_dataset: create a Matterport3dDatasetV1 instance that loads EQA episodes from a gzipped JSON data file
test_check_config_paths: test the Matterport3dDatasetV1 check_config_paths_exist method to verify dataset file availability
review_from_json_method: review the Matterport3dDatasetV1 from_json method that deserializes episodes with vocabularies and goals
summarize_eqa_episode_loading: summarize how EQA episodes are loaded with questions, object goals, view points, and shortest paths
